title: Night of the Living Dead
description: A group of strangers barricade themselves inside a farmhouse as the reanimated dead close in. Public domain due to a missing copyright notice on original prints.

title: His Girl Friday
description: A newspaper editor tries to win back his ex-wife and star reporter for one last big story. Entered the public domain after its copyright was not renewed.

title: Plan 9 from Outer Space
description: Aliens attempt to stop humanity from creating a doomsday weapon by reanimating the dead. Widely circulated in the public domain after lapse of copyright renewal.

title: Nosferatu
description: An unauthorized silent adaptation of Dracula, an early landmark of horror cinema. Public domain as a pre-1929 work.
